headline: Economic activity likely fell in September; likely grew 0.2% in October: IOAE
summary: Mexico's economic activity indicator IOAE suggests output fell in September and grew 0.2% in October. The latest data point to a loss of momentum in the economy at the close of the third quarter of 2026.
why: The IOAE is a timely monthly gauge of Mexican economic activity, used by investors to track growth ahead of official statistics.
original_headline: Actividad económica habría caído en septiembre; en octubre habría crecido 0.2%: IOAE
